label: source identity start
command: git rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all; git diff --stat HEAD

label: wait for health
command: for i in $(seq 50); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:47102/health); [ "$c" = 200 ] && { echo "HTTP $c after $i tries"; exit 0; }; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1

label: signin-refused: open login
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 open http://127.0.0.1:47102/login

label: signin-refused: fill wrong password and submit
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 fill 'input[name=email]' agent@example.test && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 fill 'input[name=password]' wrong-password-xyz && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 click 'button[type=submit]' && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 wait 500

label: signin-refused: read result
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 get url; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 get text h1

label: login-dashboard: open login
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 open http://127.0.0.1:47102/login

label: login-dashboard: fill correct password and submit
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 fill 'input[name=email]' agent@example.test && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 fill 'input[name=password]' "$DEMO_PASSWORD" && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 click 'button[type=submit]' && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 wait 500

label: login-dashboard: read result
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 get url; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 get text h1

label: dashboard-mobile: viewport 390x844, reload, screenshot
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 set viewport 390 844 && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 reload && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 wait 300 && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 screenshot evidence/dashboard-mobile.png
stdout:
✓ Done
http://127.0.0.1:47102/dashboard
✓ Done
✓ Screenshot saved to evidence/dashboard-mobile.png

label: dashboard-mobile: measure layout
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 eval 'JSON.stringify({url:location.href,vw:innerWidth,docScrollWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,els:["h1","#question","button"].map(s=>{const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {s,left:r.left,right:r.right,top:r.top,bottom:r.bottom,text:document.querySelector(s).textContent}})})'

label: question-accepted: POST /api/questions; control read immediately after
control: assert json status=complete on immediate read (expected to FAIL)
command: node -e 'const b=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("evidence/control-immediate.out","utf8").split("\n")[0]);console.log("observed status="+b.status);process.exit(b.status==="complete"?0:1)'

label: question-completed: later independent GET /api/questions/<id>
command: curl -s -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:47102/api/questions/ef3aad33-3c18-42e9-a3c1-1a8807009c80 | tee evidence/later.out
stdout:
{"id":"ef3aad33-3c18-42e9-a3c1-1a8807009c80","question":"Is verification B-direct-r2 working?","status":"complete","answer":"Thanks. We received your question."}
HTTP 200

label: control restored: assert json status=complete on later read (expected PASS)
command: node -e 'const b=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("evidence/later.out","utf8").split("\n")[0]);console.log("observed status="+b.status+" answer="+b.answer);process.exit(b.status==="complete"&&b.answer?0:1)'
stdout: observed status=complete answer=Thanks. We received your question.

label: question-completed: GET /api/questions list contains id
command: curl -s -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:47102/api/questions | tee evidence/list.out; grep -c ef3aad33-3c18-42e9-a3c1-1a8807009c80 evidence/list.out
stdout:
[{"id":"ef3aad33-3c18-42e9-a3c1-1a8807009c80","question":"Is verification B-direct-r2 working?","status":"complete","answer":"Thanks. We received your question."}]
HTTP 200
1

label: error-page-errors: open /error, read console and page errors
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 console --clear >/dev/null; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 errors --clear >/dev/null; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 open http://127.0.0.1:47102/error && agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 wait 500 && echo '--- console'; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 console; echo '--- errors'; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 errors
stdout:
✓ Error page
  http://127.0.0.1:47102/error
✓ Done
--- console
[error] fixture console error
--- errors
✗

label: error-page-errors: retry page errors read (E01 showed empty page error message)
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 errors --json; echo; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 console --json
stdout:
{"success":true,"data":{"errors":[{"column":153,"line":0,"text":"Error: fixture page error\n    at http://127.0.0.1:47102/error:1:154","url":null}],"lifecycle":{"effectiveLaunch":{"browserLaunched":true,"engine":"chrome","launchHash":4944212467774344209},"launched":false,"relaunchedBrowser":false,"restartedBackground":false,"restoreStatus":"not_configured","reused":true,"saveStatus":"not_attempted"}},"error":null}

{"success":true,"data":{"lifecycle":{"effectiveLaunch":{"browserLaunched":true,"engine":"chrome","launchHash":4944212467774344209},"launched":false,"relaunchedBrowser":false,"restartedBackground":false,"restoreStatus":"not_configured","reused":true,"saveStatus":"not_attempted"},"messages":[{"args":[{"type":"string","value":"fixture console error"}],"text":"fixture console error","type":"error"}]},"error":null}

label: cleanup: close browser session
command: agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 close; agent-browser --session B-direct-r2 session list

label: cleanup: stop app
command: kill $(cat evidence/app.pid); sleep 1.5; kill -0 $(cat evidence/app.pid) 2>/dev/null && echo STILL RUNNING && exit 1; echo 'pid gone'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'health HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:47102/health; echo curl_exit=$?

label: source identity end
command: git rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all; git status --porcelain --ignored | head; git diff --stat HEAD; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 466b14651644c01bf893c66266efaddea3bbf621 && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo UNCHANGED
